{
  "decision-crate-stack-notice-audit": "SELECT c.obs_id, c.layers_seen - n.layer_cap AS excess_layers, n.source_id, n.notice_text
FROM stack_check AS c
JOIN stack_notice AS n ON n.source_id = (
  SELECT s.source_id
  FROM stack_notice AS s
  WHERE s.crate_style = c.crate_style AND s.effective_tick <= c.tick_no
  ORDER BY s.effective_tick DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
WHERE c.layers_seen > n.layer_cap
ORDER BY c.tick_no, c.obs_id COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-crosswalk-print-blocks-from-impressions": "WITH impressions AS (
  SELECT slip_text
  FROM proof_slip
  GROUP BY slip_text COLLATE BINARY
  HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN catalog_kind = 'drawer' THEN 1 END) = 1
     AND COUNT(CASE WHEN catalog_kind = 'plate' THEN 1 END) = 1
)
SELECT q.drawer_key, p.block_key AS plate_key, d.slip_key AS drawer_source, p.slip_key AS plate_source
FROM drawer_queue AS q
JOIN proof_slip AS d ON d.block_key = q.drawer_key AND d.catalog_kind = 'drawer'
JOIN impressions AS i ON i.slip_text COLLATE BINARY = d.slip_text
JOIN proof_slip AS p ON p.slip_text COLLATE BINARY = i.slip_text AND p.catalog_kind = 'plate'
ORDER BY q.drawer_key COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-cumulative-holdback-on-progress-bills": "WITH running AS (
  SELECT b.job_code, b.bill_seq, b.gross_cents, n.source_id, n.rate_bp, n.cap_cents,
         SUM(b.gross_cents) OVER (PARTITION BY b.job_code ORDER BY b.bill_seq ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_gross
  FROM work_bill AS b
  JOIN hold_notice AS n ON n.job_code = b.job_code
), balances AS (
  SELECT job_code, bill_seq, gross_cents, source_id,
         MIN(cap_cents, (cumulative_gross / 10000) * rate_bp + (cumulative_gross % 10000) * rate_bp / 10000) AS held_cents
  FROM running
)
SELECT job_code, bill_seq, source_id, held_cents,
       gross_cents - (held_cents - LAG(held_cents, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY job_code ORDER BY bill_seq)) AS due_cents
FROM balances
ORDER BY job_code COLLATE BINARY, bill_seq",
  "decision-customer-relationship-value-from-mature-renewals": "WITH pooled AS (
  SELECT segment_code, SUM(opening_accounts) AS completed_accounts, SUM(renewed_accounts) AS renewed_accounts
  FROM renewal_cohort
  WHERE renewed_accounts IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY segment_code
), valuation AS (
  SELECT p.segment_code, p.completed_accounts, p.renewed_accounts,
         m.opening_margin_cents * p.renewed_accounts * (m.pv1_bp * p.completed_accounts + m.pv2_bp * p.renewed_accounts) AS numerator,
         10000 * p.completed_accounts * p.completed_accounts AS denominator
  FROM pooled AS p
  JOIN segment_model AS m ON m.segment_code = p.segment_code
)
SELECT segment_code, completed_accounts, renewed_accounts,
       CAST((numerator + denominator / 2) / denominator AS INTEGER) AS relationship_value_cents
FROM valuation
ORDER BY segment_code COLLATE BINARY"
}

SELECT q.drawer_key, p.block_key AS plate_key, d.slip_key AS drawer_source, p.slip_key AS plate_source
